fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint anywhere. Open suburban industrial-park access: trucks turn off McCormick Dr onto open private pavement and wrap to the south/east dock yards with no control point. Street View from McCormick frontage and the south service road shows no fence or pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. North office frontage on McCormick Dr is open landscaped parking; no booth beside any truck lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (no kiosk/call-box either).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on different building faces: a long dock bank on the south face (~26 doors) and a second dock bank on the east face (~12 doors, trailers backed into the east wall), consistent with separate commissary inbound vs DC outbound flows.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~38 total: ~26 along the south face + ~12 along the east face. 25-50 band, counted from z19-z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Angled trailer-storage rows in the south yard (~12 dropped trailers) plus an east trailer yard (~12 backed-in); marked stalls present. 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open paved yard between the building dock faces and the south service road / tree line easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Same open driveways off McCormick Dr serve both directions; no separate in/out gates.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Long Island (Islip/Bohemia) metro industrial fabric, surrounded by warehouses, flex buildings and residential; cellular coverage strong.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large multi-tenant building (Constance Food Group = 7-Eleven CDC operator, Gold Glass-ALP and others share it), not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate from yard footprint; low confidence.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large multi-tenant industrial building on the audited parcel; small neighboring buildings (Packaging Dynamics) are separate parcels.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; nearest rail is the LIRR Main Line well to the north, not connected.
